title: P1 Remediation: Thread-Safe LeanEventCache, Fallible EventProvider Error Propagation & DenseIndex/Roaring Consolidation
public_safety_audit_summary: Critical/High (Audit #2 — Operational Liveness, Cache Concurrency & Crash Resilience): Real federation fork scales reach 10^4–10^5 events (not 500–700), LeanEventCache is !Sync with O(log N) BTreeMap churn on hits, resolve_state_maps_lazy/AuthGraph panic unconditionally on missing events or u32 overflow, and DenseIndex/Roaring bitmap migrations remain incomplete.
